diagnostics.summary: function `main` must declare an explicit return type.

causes: Public APIs must not rely on inference; this checker applies the canonical rule to all functions.

diagnostics.label: unknown binding

diagnostics.summary: surface reference syntax is not part of RSScript.
diagnostics.label: surface reference attempt
causes: RSScript uses explicit data effects instead of `&T` or `&mut T` syntax.

fixes.title: Use a parameter effect such as `value: read T` or `value: mut T`.
